method.allocation_bytes: sum of requested sizes for successful alloc/alloc_zeroed
method.gross_requested_bytes: allocation bytes + realloc requested sizes, not resident/live/unique memory
method.instrumented_us: exploration only; allocation counter and concurrent agents affect CPU timing
method.realloc_requested_bytes: sum of requested NEW sizes, not incremental memory
method.transfer_setup: owned-transfer clones fixture before measured scope; copy-inside charges that clone
